title: 軽い言葉じゃ意味がねえ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In an interview broadcast on TV, Inari One declares that her next race goal is the Japan Dirt Derby. The general response is one of surprise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reporters descend on Oi to interview Chief, Inari One's old trainer before she transferred to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chief, not knowing Inari One's ultimate goal or the reason she wants to dominate the regionals, becomes furious upon hearing the news.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though I want to clear things up with him, Inari One insists we let the issue lie and that she'll prove her determination through her results. Still, I can't help but worry about leaving the misunderstanding between them.
